variants.label: Python · 回溯
variants.text:
def permutations(items):
    result = []
    used = [False] * len(items)

    def backtrack(path):
        if len(path) == len(items):
            result.append(path.copy())
            return
        for index, item in enumerate(items):
            if used[index]:
                continue
            used[index] = True
            path.append(item)
            backtrack(path)
            path.pop()
            used[index] = False

    backtrack([])
    return result
variants.note: 回溯在递归返回后撤销选择，使其他分支能够复用当前状态。

variants.label: Python · 集合剪枝
variants.text:
def count_n_queens(size):
    columns = set()
    diagonals_down = set()
    diagonals_up = set()

    def place(row):
        if row == size:
            return 1
        solutions = 0
        for column in range(size):
            down = row - column
            up = row + column
            if column in columns or down in diagonals_down or up in diagonals_up:
                continue
            columns.add(column)
            diagonals_down.add(down)
            diagonals_up.add(up)
            solutions += place(row + 1)
            columns.remove(column)
            diagonals_down.remove(down)
            diagonals_up.remove(up)
        return solutions

    return place(0)
variants.note: 同一条斜线上的格子具有相同的 row-column 或 row+column。
